text: Day four.  The meadow is kind.  Too kind.  Morrow says that is how the first floor gets you to stay.
Left the spare lantern oil under the crate.  Whoever finds this: the path east bends to water.  Follow it.
Salt line around the tents every night.  Do not skip it because the night looks quiet.
We counted nine cairns.  Took one stone for luck.  The road shut behind us by morning.  Bring it back.
Eels in the low water.  They only move when you stand in it.  Wade fast or don't wade.
If you read this, the guild owes us three weeks' marks.  Tell them the hall at the bend is a market, not a ruin.
Glowcap oil burns blue and long.  Spore haze past the fungal line; wear the mask, even when you feel fine.
The tide is thicker here than at the gate.  Your mending comes easier.  Rest-deep worked twice as well.
We heard the bell under the water at dusk.  Nobody rang it.
Packed out with two primers and a disc.  The almanac's salt line kept the crabs off the camp for an hour.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): a moss-backed cairn warden rises if a stone is stolen.

s.signage: Trail-stones.  Take one, and the road stays shut.  Bring three back to the cairns, and the old road opens.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): a gatehouse sentinel blocks the bar until driven off.

s.signage: GATE LEDGER.  The bar lifts for those who answer: "What has a gate but no wall, and a road but no feet?"

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): the grove keeper wakes if the firepit is looted.

s.signage: Rekindle the pit with three hearthwood brands, and the grove will warm you again.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): a stone-bound shade lashes out if the circle is broken.

s.signage: The stones mark the weather: "I fall without rain, I come without cloud.  What am I?"

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): the shrine spirit turns if the bowl is emptied dry.

s.signage: Fill the bowl from three named springs, and the shrine keeps you.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): the swarm bursts if pots are smashed open.

s.signage: Smoke the skeps before you take the honey.  Break none.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): orchard husks rake anyone who climbs the ladder.

s.signage: Press one marked bushel and carry the cider to the gatehouse ledger.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): the well-dweller climbs if the bucket is yanked free.

s.signage: "I came in with the traveller and left without him.  What am I?"  (Chalked on the well rim.)

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): the arch guardian bars the gate until paid or forced.

s.signage: TOLL: one hearthwood token, carved at the cairns.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): night watchers spawn if every lantern is smashed.

s.signage: Light every post before dusk, and the road keeps its watchers sleeping.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): the bell warden rings and floods the plaza in combat.

s.signage: "I speak when struck and the water answers.  Find my tongue, and I will ring you home."

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): market reeves drive looters into the canals.

s.signage: MARKET RULE: keep the ledgers dry.  A dry page is owed to the ferry.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): warehouse drowners attack only while you stand in water.

s.signage: Clapper rack: one missing.  Return it to the bell on the plinth.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): sluice guardians punish the wrong wheel order.

s.signage: Open only the three wheels named in the ledger.  The wrong order brings the rush.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): a lock-beast surges when the crank is forced.

s.signage: "I hold the water and let it go; I am opened by a turn and closed by a weight."

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): the chapel idol animates if the altar bronze is pried.

s.signage: "Three gifts were laid here: one to keep, one to give, one to leave.  Which do you take?"

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): orchard tenders strike only while you wade the rows.

s.signage: Dry three racks.  Cut no living stake.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): the hulk captain's remnant boards anyone who breaks the cabin.

s.signage: Passenger names in chalk.  "I carried them all and none of them paid.  Who am I?"

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): marker shades attack if posts are uprooted.

s.signage: Safe wade heights by hour.  Copy them for the sluice ledger.

//: Grok WP-D1.  Hostile variant (not built yet): loom-spinners drop if bolts are torn free.

s.signage: Finish one bolt with pins from the chapel, and the looms are yours to use.

Grok WP-G6.  cold fire ring, lean-to frame, chalk trail notes  Hostile variant (not built yet): bandits? no — meadow has no hunters; spooked flock stampedes

s.signage: Rekindle and leave a ration for the next traveler.

//: Grok WP-G6.  healleaf, feverfew, mint in broken stone beds  Hostile variant (not built yet): garden husks rise if beds are ripped out

s.signage: Gather three named herbs for the wayshrine bowl.

s.signage: The_passenger.

s.signage: Reset three snares without killing a hare.

s.signage: Smoke-harvest without breaking a comb.

s.signage: Quarry_gate.

//: Grok WP-G6.  mud wallow, shed antlers, soft tracks  Hostile variant (not built yet): deer bolt; no combat spawn

s.signage: Leave salt and wait for a calm sighting.

s.signage: Keep the pit lit through one night.

//: Grok WP-G6.  circle of scarecrows facing inward on grain  Hostile variant (not built yet): all animate at dusk

s.signage: Replace three coats without waking them.

//: Grok WP-G6.  half-roofed barn, loft, rusted tool racks  Hostile variant (not built yet): barn king drops from loft

s.signage: Clear loft and hang a new lantern.

s.signage: Weather_no_cloud.

//: Grok WP-G6.  oldest feral trees, press ruin, wasp nests  Hostile variant (not built yet): husks + swarm if press forced

s.signage: Press one marked bushel at dusk.

//: Grok WP-G6.  thorny gate in living hedge, stuck latch  Hostile variant (not built yet): beast blocks until latch puzzle solved

s.signage: Open latch with flax cord only.

//: Grok WP-G6.  broken mill, grindstone, flour dust  Hostile variant (not built yet): spirit crushes looters on the stone

s.signage: Grind a tribute sack for the herdsman.

//: Grok WP-G6.  cut swath through cutting grain, scythe marks  Hostile variant (not built yet): reaper patrols the path

s.signage: Walk the path silent before dawn.

//: Grok WP-G6.  rotting hive boxes, wax trays, smoker husk  Hostile variant (not built yet): swarm bursts if boxes smashed

s.signage: Smoke and take wax without a sting storm.

//: Grok WP-G6.  straw crook, flock pens, dusk fire  Hostile variant (not built yet): herdsman turns hostile if flock harmed

s.signage: Help herd three sheep into the pen.

//: Grok WP-G6.  old marl pit, buckets, kiln bricks  Hostile variant (not built yet): pit collapses if over-dug

s.signage: Dig a safe terrace for the kiln.

//: Grok WP-G6.  deepest grain ring; Harvest Lord waits  Hostile variant (not built yet): full hostile harvest

s.signage: Three_gifts.

//: Grok WP-G6.  half-sunk pier, verdigris bollards, tied wreck  Hostile variant (not built yet): claw rises if bollards pried

s.signage: Retie three lines at low water.

//: Grok WP-G6.  reed frames, pitch pots, half-built boats  Hostile variant (not built yet): otters flee; yard traps if pitch stolen cold

s.signage: Finish one coracle for the ferry hulk.

//: Grok WP-G6.  wicker weir across a channel, spear rack  Hostile variant (not built yet): eels attack only in water

s.signage: Empty the weir without standing in deep water.

//: Grok WP-G6.  oxcart sunk to the axle, dry crate on top  Hostile variant (not built yet): slugs if crate smashed underwater

s.signage: Salvage the dry crate intact.

//: Grok WP-G6.  stilt hut by a lock, ledger, crank key  Hostile variant (not built yet): lobster if crank forced wrong

s.signage: The_lab.

//: Grok WP-G6.  weeping willow shrine, bowl of bog berries  Hostile variant (not built yet): shrine shade if bowl emptied dry

s.signage: Refill bowl from three bog bushes.

//: Grok WP-G6.  stilt loft of drying nets and floats  Hostile variant (not built yet): beetles if nets torn

s.signage: Mend one net with sea-silk thread.

//: Grok WP-G6.  plaza deep seat around the harbour bell  Hostile variant (not built yet): bell warden floods plaza

s.signage: Harbour_bell.

//: Grok WP-G6.  charred lookout tower, signal mirror, ash  Hostile variant (not built yet): firebird nests if tower climbed loud

s.signage: Light the signal without starting a grassfire.

//: Grok WP-G6.  mud wallow, dung cakes, shed horns  Hostile variant (not built yet): stampede if calves threatened

s.signage: Take one shed horn without startling the herd.

//: Grok WP-G6.  blackened grass oval, ash, resprouting shrubs  Hostile variant (not built yet): wisps ignite if ash stirred

s.signage: Map the scar edge for the fire tower.

//: Grok WP-G6.  mound field, sentry holes, salt lick nearby  Hostile variant (not built yet): queen collapses tunnels if nest robbed

s.signage: Trade ghostsalt for a safe path.

//: Grok WP-G6.  hidden den in cutting grass, bone scatter  Hostile variant (not built yet): cats ambush on exit

s.signage: Leave smoked meat and pass unharmed.

//: Grok WP-G6.  glassy flint scatter on a low rise  Hostile variant (not built yet): cutting grass closes if rise stripped bare

s.signage: Take only three flakes for the fire kit.

//: Grok WP-G6.  camp under the lone prairie tree, thatch lean-to  Hostile variant (not built yet): wolves if meat left out overnight

s.signage: Share pemmican with a traveler mark.

//: Grok WP-G6.  cleared strip, rake marks, scorched edges  Hostile variant (not built yet): wisps if you carry open flame

s.signage: Extend the break by three tiles.

//: Grok WP-G6.  cairn of bison horns, chalk herd marks  Hostile variant (not built yet): bull challenges if horn taken

s.signage: Quarry_gate.

//: Grok WP-G6.  deep wallow throne of hides and horns  Hostile variant (not built yet): full herd hostility

s.signage: Present a fire-tower signal token.

//: Grok WP-G6.  ground vent pulsing pale spores into haze  Hostile variant (not built yet): venter floods haze if approached unmasked

s.signage: Cap the vent with a myceloth patch.

//: Grok WP-G6.  dense glowcap clusters, soft carpet, blue light  Hostile variant (not built yet): grazer defends if caps stripped bare

s.signage: Harvest without extinguishing every glow.

//: Grok WP-G6.  ground that softens inward; black water pools  Hostile variant (not built yet): maw opens under heavy steps

s.signage: Cross on stalk-fibre mats only.

//: Grok WP-G6.  cap-beetle nest mound, chitin litter  Hostile variant (not built yet): carriers burst spores if nest cracked

s.signage: Take plates from the shed pile only.

//: Grok WP-G6.  hanging veil curtains forming a hall  Hostile variant (not built yet): wraiths if curtains torn

s.signage: The_passenger.

//: Grok WP-G6.  fairy ring of violet poison caps  Hostile variant (not built yet): slugs if caps crushed

s.signage: Mark the ring without touching caps.

//: Grok WP-G6.  spore-masked lean-to, filter disc rack  Hostile variant (not built yet): harmless until haze thickens

s.signage: Leave a spare filter for the next traveler.

//: Grok WP-G6.  lair smelling of violet chitin and meat  Hostile variant (not built yet): hunters ambush on exit

s.signage: Pass wearing a full spore suit.

//: Grok WP-G6.  trampled clearing under a cap colossus route  Hostile variant (not built yet): colossus shakes spores each step

s.signage: Observe from veil hall and map its path.

//: Grok WP-G6.  Hungering core seat under the vast mind-cap  Hostile variant (not built yet): full haze war

s.signage: Three_gifts.

//: Grok WP-G6.  root-arch bridge over a black sinkhole  Hostile variant (not built yet): lurker drops if you run

s.signage: Cross using pitons, no shouting.

//: Grok WP-G6.  open dig face, ore carts, emberstone hearth  Hostile variant (not built yet): eater if picks ring loud

s.signage: Mine with muffled tools only.

//: Grok WP-G6.  chamber where every sound triples  Hostile variant (not built yet): shades form if you speak

s.signage: Weather_no_cloud.

//: Grok WP-G6.  root arches hung with dark combs  Hostile variant (not built yet): swarm if combs smashed

s.signage: Smoke-harvest two combs quietly.

//: Grok WP-G6.  grotto of heartglass geodes, pink glow  Hostile variant (not built yet): crabs if geodes cracked open

s.signage: Take one shed shard only.

//: Grok WP-G6.  fossil bone locked in a root arch  Hostile variant (not built yet): ambush root if bone pried loose

s.signage: Copy the bone marks for the journal.

//: Grok WP-G6.  mute moss shrine, soft bowl, no echo  Hostile variant (not built yet): warden if you make noise inside

s.signage: Sit silent one minute; receive mute wrap.

//: Grok WP-G6.  stand of ironwood, resin weeps, metallic bark  Hostile variant (not built yet): roots lash if axes ring

s.signage: Take fallen scrap only.

//: Grok WP-G6.  den lined with chewed vein stone  Hostile variant (not built yet): tyrant shakes ground

s.signage: Lure tyrant onto a mute-moss mat.

//: Grok WP-G6.  practice pitons, chalk bag, short drop  Hostile variant (not built yet): ledge collapses if overloaded

s.signage: Place three pitons correctly.

//: Grok WP-G6.  Dormant taproot core among giant root knees  Hostile variant (not built yet): full sound-drawn assault

s.signage: Harbour_bell.
